item.title: Determining Docker Host IP Address from Within a Container
item.description:
“Determining Docker Host IP Address from Within a Container”

How does an application running inside a Docker container reliably ascertain the network address of the host machine it resides on? This requirement frequently arises when containers need to communicate with services bound exclusively to the host’s primary network interface, such as databases, development tools, or specific monitoring agents. Due to network isolation inherent in containerization, this is often non-trivial and highly dependent on the host OS, Docker version, and network mode employed.

item.title: Docker EXPOSE vs -p Port Mapping Distinctions and Behavior

“Docker EXPOSE vs -p Port Mapping Distinctions and Behavior”

The interaction between EXPOSE and publishing ports (-p or -P) dictates how services running inside a Docker container can be reached, both from within the Docker ecosystem and from the external host environment. It’s crucial to recognize that these are distinct mechanisms operating at different stages: image definition versus container execution.
